_doc: Lookup catalog of Capture/PSpice parts used in this project. Speeds placement by caching OLB paths, pin names, props, and crash-safe recipes. Pin geometry lives in pin_offsets.json (same lib/part keys).

page._note: Keep PlacePart origins inside [xmin,ymin,xmax,ymax]. Lab9 parts at y>11 were invisible / off-page.

crash_rules: One Tcl command per socket send (execute_tcl_batch still sends separately with delay)
Never bulk DeletePartInst / DeleteGlobal / Select-All Delete
Never DeleteGlobal in a loop after mass ground delete — Capture often crashes
Fairchild 2N7000 prop edits crash — use MbreakN + MODEL 2N7000
PlacePart bipolar.olb Q2N3904 in large batches has crashed — place alone or reuse design-cache instance
Always Menu {File::Save} after SetLocation moves before further edits
Always trailing newline on each Tcl command
Never PlacePart VPULSE via Tcl (crashed Capture) - place VDC and patch the pulse spec into the .cir
Never SetRotation via Tcl (hangs Capture) - keep R/C horizontal and route wires
Never Menu {File::Save} inside a DeleteWire loop (crashed Capture) - save after the loop

R.use: Horizontal resistor. Pin1 left, pin2 right at rot0. For vertical collector load, still place horizontal and wire vertically to pin tips.

C.use: Series coupling / bypass. Pin1 left, pin2 right.

L.use: Series inductor. Longer body than R.

VDC.use: DC supply. + at top of symbol, - below. Wire - straight down to ground hotspot.

VAC.use: AC small-signal source for .AC sweeps. Prefer V([node]) in .PRINT/.PROBE.

VSIN.use: Transient sine. Combines DC offset + amplitude (Lab9 base drive). Prop names VOFF/VAMPL/FREQ.

VPULSE.use: Pulse source (Lab5 doubler). Confirm prop names on first place.

GND.use: Place at (desired_hs_x - 0.1, desired_hs_y). Wire ONLY straight down from above into hotspot. Never SetLocation after place.
GND.danger: DeleteGlobal loops and SetLocation on grounds crash Capture

Q2N3904.use: NPN BJT (Lab9). Place ONE at a time. After first place, design-cache is warm. Pins: c top, b left, e bottom (rot0).
Q2N3904.danger: Batch PlacePart of bipolar.olb has crashed sessions — use batch_max_place=1

QbreakN.use: Generic NPN breakout. Prefer when bipolar.olb PlacePart is unstable. Set MODEL to Q2N3904; ensure bipolar.lib on sim profile.
QbreakN.note: Measure pins on first use in a session and update pin_offsets.json if they differ from Q2N3904

MbreakN.use: NMOS breakout (Lab8). Prefer over Fairchild 2N7000 symbol. Set MODEL after place.

Dbreak.use: Generic diode breakout when specific OLB fails. Set MODEL to target diode.

1N4148.use: Lab3 signal diode. Dedicated OLB — PlacePart alone first to warm cache.

1N5231.use: Zener. If OLB place fails, use Dbreak + MODEL D1N5231.

1N6263.use: Lab5 Schottky. Ensure .lib registered in PSpice.ini.

TL074.use: Lab2 op-amp (section A). MUST place as TL074/301/TI with device A — bare TL074 raises ORCAP-1687 and blocks Tcl socket with a modal OK dialog.
TL074.danger: PlacePart TL074 without /301/TI or without device A → ORCAP-1687 modal that freezes port 9020 until OK is clicked

TL081.use: Single BiFET op-amp (ECEN 4013 Bessel LPF homework). Place as TL081/301/TI with empty device. Leave N1/N2 (offset null) open.
TL081.danger: Do not route wires along the OUT x-column — N1 and N2 share that X. tex_inst PlacePart: save after every place.

bessel_lpf_n5.title: ECEN 4013 Wk2 N=5 Bessel LPF fc=3 kHz (TL081 Sallen-Key)
bessel_lpf_n5.note: Unity-gain 2nd-order SK + 3rd-order VCVS. Leave TL081 N1/N2 open.

ce_amp_fig5.title: Lab9 Fig5 common-emitter (sim schematic)
ce_amp_fig5.wiring: VSIN+→Q.b; Q.c→RC.2 vertical; RC.1→VCC+; VSIN-/Q.e/VCC- → GND down

lab8_cs_amp_fig6.title: Lab8 Fig6 common-source amp (2N7000)
lab8_cs_amp_fig6.note: Tie MbreakN bulk to source; never Fairchild 2N7000 + Reference prop edits

tcl_snippets.list_parts: set lStatus [DboState]; set lNullObj NULL; set lPage [GetActivePage]; set out {}; set lIter [$lPage NewPartInstsIter $lStatus]; set lInst [$lIter NextPartInst $lStatus]; while {$lInst != $lNullObj} { set ref [DboTclHelper_sMakeCString]; $lInst GetReference $ref; set loc [$lInst GetLocation $lStatus]; set ox [expr {[DboTclHelper_sGetCPointX $loc]/100.0}]; set oy [expr {[DboTclHelper_sGetCPointY $loc]/100.0}]; lappend out "[DboTclHelper_sGetConstCharPtr $ref]@$ox,$oy"; set lInst [$lIter NextPartInst $lStatus] }; delete_DboPagePartInstsIter $lIter; return [join $out { | }]
tcl_snippets.delete_one_part: set lStatus [DboState]; set lNullObj NULL; set lPage [GetActivePage]; set lIter [$lPage NewPartInstsIter $lStatus]; set victim NULL; set lInst [$lIter NextPartInst $lStatus]; while {$lInst != $lNullObj} { set victim $lInst; set lInst [$lIter NextPartInst $lStatus]}; delete_DboPagePartInstsIter $lIter; if {$victim != $lNullObj} { $lPage DeletePartInst $victim; return deleted } else { return none }
tcl_snippets.delete_one_wire: set lStatus [DboState]; set lNullObj NULL; set lPage [GetActivePage]; set wIter [$lPage NewWiresIter $lStatus]; set w [$wIter NextWire $lStatus]; delete_DboPageWiresIter $wIter; if {$w != $lNullObj} { $lPage DeleteWire $w; return dw } else { return none }
